sites.text: Follow mode records the startup byte size and reads `session_meta` once. It skips complete records in that snapshot. A persistent `tail` reader starts at the first unread record, retaining an unfinished startup record until its newline arrives. A background supervisor checks the owner every three seconds. When the owner exits, the watcher stops the follower and drains unread records to EOF before stopping. Unexpected reader or supervisor failures return nonzero with diagnostics. The launcher must stop and reap its watcher during cleanup. The file must already exist and contain session metadata. Replacement or truncation requires a new watcher; ephemeral sessions without a rollout cannot be watched. `--once` deliberately processes existing records to EOF instead of following them, and can post historical failure banners. Do not use it to activate live monitoring.
